purpose: Bounded, official-source audit of significant released paper product families whose Scryfall category is not expansion/core. Not a complete census of every supplemental product.

premier_reference.section: Premier sets described as the four major yearly Standard-format releases in 2022; Masters, Modern Horizons, Secret Lair, UB discussed separately.
premier_reference.policy_note: 2025-and-later Universes Beyond main booster content becomes Standard legal, but the change is forward-only and does not alter 2023 LTR or 2024 ACR.

records.evidence_note: ACR cards are Modern, Commander, Legacy and Vintage legal; new cards do not enter Standard/Pioneer.
Wizards identifies Commander Masters as a Masters reprint set; not a mainline Standard premier release.
Commander-draft product with special booster construction, rather than normal Standard release.
Wizards describes a remastered set of prior Innistrad reprints.
New J22 cards enter Eternal formats, not Standard/Pioneer/Modern.
Commander companion to the LTR modern-legal full release; new LTC cards are Eternal legal.

records.section: 2023 Universes Beyond full release: Modern but not Standard
records.evidence_note: Wizards describes the 2023 full product as non-Standard-legal; its Scryfall category is draft_innovation.
Wizards explicitly describes MH1 as supplemental instead of Standard premier.
MH2 releases directly into Modern and Eternal, not Standard.
MH3 enters Modern and Eternal rather than Standard.
Fallout PIP is Commander/Eternal legal, not a mainline Standard premiere.
Wizards describes an edition built of older Ravnica cards/reprints.

localized_printing_leads.notes: Cardmarket describes localized black-bordered Revised editions with their base edition card pool, not an independent regular core edition.
Cardmarket describes localized Fourth Edition black-bordered printings in new languages, not a different base edition.
